value.rationale: Spanning-tree edge molecules are the canonical coordinate basis for a finite metric transportation space, so their unconditional constant quantifies basis stability under independent sign perturbations. An exact graph-wide formula covers arbitrary finite weighted cactus networks and all their spanning trees, not isolated instances. The sharp r-1 unit-cycle growth and integer-weight discrepancy threshold reveal both geometric instability and NP-complete exact threshold evaluation. This natural parameter-family classification is not a renamed known table or a tiny numeric improvement; no larger conjecture is claimed.
